title: The Complaint Becomes an Armed Pursuit

blocks.text: The Singhs reject the charge outright, answering singh ji kahi ch singh nahin chôra and refusing to accept a lie merely to avoid punishment.
Instead, the page shows them ready to accept death rather than hiding, because yahi tô ham nai hai mithî sir turkan lâygu deh turns martyrdom into a sweeter choice than dishonour.
That answer enrages authority: suni hâkam tis lag gai aga, intelligence is gathered, and assî payâdô pafijhî asvâra signals the movement from complaint to armed mobilization.
